gitlens-lite.currentLine.enabled.markdownDescription: Specifies whether to provide an inline blame annotation for the current line, by default. Use the `Toggle Line Blame Annotations` command (`gitlens.toggleLineBlame`) to toggle the annotations on and off for the current window

gitlens-lite.currentLine.format.markdownDescription: Specifies the format of the inline blame annotation. See [_Commit Tokens_](https://github.com/gitkraken/vscode-gitlens/wiki/Custom-Formatting#commit-tokens) in the GitLens docs. Date formatting is controlled by the `#gitlens-lite.currentLine.dateFormat#` setting

gitlens-lite.currentLine.uncommittedChan.markdownDescription:
Specifies the uncommitted changes format of the inline blame annotation. See [_Commit Tokens_](https://github.com/gitkraken/vscode-gitlens/wiki/Custom-Formatting#commit-tokens) in the GitLens docs. Date formatting is controlled by the `#gitlens-lite.currentLine.dateFormat#` setting.

**NOTE**: Setting this to an empty string will disable inline blame annotations for uncommitted changes.

gitlens-lite.currentLine.scrollable.markdownDescription: Specifies whether the inline blame annotation can be scrolled into view when it is outside the viewport. **NOTE**: Setting this to `false` will inhibit the hovers from showing over the annotation. gitlens-lite.currentLine.dateFormat.markdownDescription: Specifies how to format absolute dates (e.g. using the `${date}` token) for the inline blame annotation, when not specified `#gitlens-lite.defaultDateFormat#` is used. gitlens-lite.advanced.externalDiffTool.markdownDescription: Specifies an optional external diff tool to use when comparing files. Must be a configured [Git difftool](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-config#Documentation/git-config.txt-difftool).

gitlens-lite.advanced.externalDirectoryD.markdownDescription: Specifies an optional external diff tool to use when comparing directories. Must be a configured [Git difftool](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-config#Documentation/git-config.txt-difftool).

gitlens-lite.advanced.quickPick.closeOnF.markdownDescription: Specifies whether to dismiss quick pick menus when focus is lost (if not, press `ESC` to dismiss)

gitlens-lite.advanced.skipOnboarding.markdownDescription: Specifies whether to skip onboarding experiences, such as welcome views and walkthroughs. Useful for ephemeral environments like containers or sandboxes

gitlens-lite.advanced.git.timeout.markdownDescription: Specifies the timeout (in seconds) for Git commands. Use 0 to disable the timeout. Some long-running operations like merge, rebase, and revert always have the timeout disabled

gitlens-lite.advanced.git.maxConcurrentP.markdownDescription: Specifies the maximum number of background Git processes that can run concurrently. Reduce this value if you experience system slowdowns with large repositories

gitlens-lite.advanced.maxListItems.markdownDescription: Specifies the maximum number of items to show in a list. Use 0 to specify no maximum

gitlens-lite.advanced.maxSearchItems.markdownDescription: Specifies the maximum number of items to show in a search. Use 0 to specify no maximum

gitlens-lite.advanced.caching.gitPath.markdownDescription: Specifies whether to cache (per-workspace) the path to the Git executable to use for GitLens

gitlens-lite.gitOptimizations.enabled.markdownDescription: Specifies whether GitLens will automatically apply safe, repo-local Git performance optimizations in the background (loose-object packing, incremental repack, and commit-graph) while VS Code is open. This is the same routine work Git performs during `git gc`/`git maintenance`: packing and repacking reorganize objects the repository already contains without altering history, while the commit-graph is a pure acceleration cache that can be deleted at any time. More invasive optimizations (untracked cache, FSMonitor, system-scheduled maintenance, `feature.manyFiles`) are never applied automatically

gitlens-lite.advanced.resolveSymlinks.markdownDescription: Specifies whether to resolve symbolic links when determining file paths for Git operations

gitlens-lite.advanced.commits.delayLoadi.markdownDescription: Specifies whether to delay loading commit file details until they are shown. Delaying makes large histories open faster but adds a Git call each time a commit's files are shown. Use `null` to delay only in repositories where loading file details has been slow (requires `gitlens-lite.gitOptimizations.enabled`)

gitlens-lite.showWhatsNewAfterUpgrades.markdownDescription: Specifies whether to show the What's New notification after upgrading to new feature releases

gitlens-lite.outputLevel.markdownDeprecationMessage: This setting is deprecated. Use the **GitLens: Enable Debug (Trace) Logging** and **GitLens: Disable Debug (Trace) Logging** commands, or the **Developer: Set Log Level...** command to control logging.
